title: Reconciliation items opened and closed through read-time derivation only, so no inbox-item-changed reached the streams as wire contracts section 10 requires
resolution: The card projector compares each projected card's reconciliation items, and on an unrecorded-process touch the installation's, with their last published projection and publishes inbox-item-changed once per change; PostgreSQL tests fail before the fix (fb-15b-p1-1.log).

title: The answer service replayed a held key or refused it as reused before it checked that the item belongs to the requested scope
resolution: The service locates the item in the requested scope before it reads the key; a service test fails before the fix (fb-15b-p1-2.log), and an HTTP replay test after a lost role or scope, red under a mutation that skips the item check (fb-15b-p1-M2-auth.log), follows the coordinator's constraint.

title: The in-memory answer key and reconciliation answer stores returned their held records, so a reader could change a stored outcome or audit record
resolution: Both in-memory stores return a structured copy on every read; a new conformance case in each shared suite changes a read record and expects the next read unchanged, and fails for both in-memory stores before the fix while the PostgreSQL adapters pass it (fb-15b-p1-3.log).

title: A historical execution item took the task's current ownership generation and, when not started, the task's latest change time, so later task changes rewrote it
resolution: The subject names the execution's grant generation, and a not-started execution closes at the time the projector first recorded it closed; a PostgreSQL test that changes the task's time and generation afterwards fails before the fix (fb-15b-p1-1.log).

title: No PostgreSQL test showed that a native answer's consumption rolls back when the outer inbox key record fails
resolution: A PostgreSQL test with the composed native source fails the key record after the native consumption and expects the session, native key, item, audit, events, and inbox keys unchanged, then retries and replays; it fails under the earlier unbound timeline binding (fb-15b-p1-5.log).

title: The product ports ownership table still attributed the reconciliation source to item 44
resolution: The table attributes the source to sub-change 15b of item 15 and leaves item 44 the queue's own surface and re-admission.

title: The touch trigger fired only on new unrecorded processes, so the processes recorded before the migration published no open item until another arrived
resolution: The up migration writes one unrecorded-process touch per worker with earlier processes, with a scenario in the postgres-state delta; a migration test that records processes before it fails before the fix (fb-15b-p2-1.log).

title: The item read before the body opened a read-write SERIALIZABLE transaction, and an answer derived its reconciliation item twice, walking every card of the project each time
resolution: The item read runs in a read-only snapshot of the view sources, and a reconciliation source, one per snapshot or transaction, hands its last item read to the answer that follows; a service test and a source test fail before the fix (fb-15b-p2-2.log). The source port is unchanged.

title: The conflict failures of the answer key and reconciliation answer adapters named no reason, which a CommandConflict requires
resolution: Both adapters of each port answer idempotency-key-reused for a held key and already-answered for a resolved item, and the conformance cases check the reason; they fail before the fix on all four adapters (fb-15b-p2-3.log).

title: No race test covered two concurrent answers over the composed native source, whose own key shares the answer's transaction
resolution: A PostgreSQL test holds two identical native answers at the key read with a barrier and checks that one answer, one inbox key, and one native key commit and that both callers get it.

title: The down step over every later table checked only the inbox answer keys after the board cards down migration ran first
resolution: The step also checks that the two other tables and both functions are gone; a down migration that keeps reconciliation_item_projections fails it (fb-15b-p2-5.log).

title: The board reads named the reconciliation records a queue read, although the closing times are the card projector's record
resolution: Renamed to ReconciliationRecordReads, since ReconciliationReads already names the source's reads, with a comment naming the queue, the answers, and the projector's closing times.

title: Design decision 2 located the answered item a second time for a new key, although the service locates it once
resolution: Decision 2 now calls the located item's source for a new key.

title: Tasks 6.1 and 6.2 were done according to the verification record but left unchecked
resolution: Tasks 6.1, 6.2, and 6.3 are ticked with the pass 2 records.
